overlays.label: SMASH · current reconstruction
overlays.credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/SMASH/D. Nidever; image processing: Travis Rector, Mahdi Zamani & Davide de Martin
overlays.registrationNote: Current cloud color source. Full 6737 × 6536 image; about 9.35° × 9.07°. Publisher sky coordinates anchor the matched-star comparison. No manual scale or rotation is applied. Covers only part of the full simulated stellar field.

overlays.label: ESO VISTA · infrared, star-aligned
overlays.registrationNote: 8954 × 10000 ESO Y/J/Ks image; about 7.7° × 8.6°. Scale, rotation and handedness fitted to 16,020 SMASH stars; 5,340 held out, P90 error 0.67 SMASH pixels (~3.3 arcsec), matched hull 83%. Corrected the publisher placement; corners outside the matched hull are extrapolated. Infrared display colors; still partial density coverage. Awaiting approval before cloud processing.

overlays.label: NASA WISE · 24° infrared candidate
overlays.registrationNote: Widest candidate: 6000 × 6000 pixels across 24°, with full pixel coverage. NASA WISE infrared data, display colors by CDS (not visible-light color). ~14.6 arcsec/pixel sampling. Rectangular atlas color/brightness seams cross the LMC: preview only, not approved for cloud processing. FITS orientation verified; independent star-field alignment pending.
